create_Tokens_ngrams: create a Tokens object and extract all ngrams up to length n from tokenized text
create_Tokens_entity_groups: create a Tokens object and group consecutive NER entity tokens by their tag
create_Tokens_words: create a Tokens object and extract a list of word tokens with optional lowercasing
create_Tokens_untokenize: create a Tokens object and reconstruct the original text with whitespace from tokens
create_Tokenizer_subclass: create a Tokenizer subclass that implements the tokenize method to return a Tokens object
